name: RuleBuilder
title: Templates/Platform/Edit/RuleBuilder
summary: A rule builder drawer, the richest form pattern: a large right-side drawer with General, Phase, Criteria, Behaviors and Status sections over a single Save in the footer. Name shows its required state only after Save is pressed with it empty, never on first render. Criteria are an `AttributeEditor` in grouped mode: AND groups of variable, operator and argument rows joined by OR, the variable a `Combobox` of the phase's variables, with Add condition, Add OR group, limits and announcements from the editor, and conditions and groups that reorder by grip, Move up and Move down, or Alt+Arrow keys (`reorderable`); behaviors are a second `AttributeEditor` (list mode, `reorderable`, up to 10) labelled Then, whose argument cell follows the behavior picked from a searchable list filtered by phase; Add behavior waits while the last behavior ends the rule. Every form resets when the drawer opens, so its content stays in place while it closes. A resource’s Rules tab opens it as Add Rule or Edit Rule. A save that fails keeps the drawer open with a danger `Alert`. Built from `SettingsSection`, `SettingRow`, `Drawer` and its parts, `PanelHeader`, `PanelContent`, `PanelFooter`, `Field`, `Input`, `HelperText`, `Select`, `AttributeEditor`, `Combobox`, `RadioButton` choice cards, `Card`, `Item`, `Switch`, `Alert` and `Button`.
